Every modified source is exactly the original plus one alias line and native_uv qualification for uv_buf_t or UV_*; full before and after bytes are recovered independently by segmented assembly. Control names and all other assertion expressions remain byte-identical.

Both canonical owner modules already occur in each original installed test-root literal closure, and both complete test-root module sets remain identical after overlaying all four corrected files.
